purpose: Bounded off-host packet for establishing the already-approved HOLY-127 fixed installer surface; it does not itself authorize execution.

payload.contents: The fourteen hash-pinned source payloads in HOLY-127-QUALIFIER-INSTALL-MANIFEST.json plus scripts/holy127_qualifier_installer.py at SHA-256 212184f578c567595ebbc547d0486af2e635b4306c68a6435935222676cb3e1e.

exclusiveCollisionPolicy: The bootstrap refuses any occupied source-parent or installer target and never overwrites it. It requires fixed root ownership, exact modes, no symlinks, exact archive size/hash/member set, and per-file hashes before mutation.
onlyMutations: the qualification bundle, three qualifier entrypoints, shared release lock and exact three-command sudo policy already enumerated by HOLY-127-QUALIFIER-INSTALL-MANIFEST.json
forbidden: arbitrary shell, Python, Docker, sudo or filesystem arguments
operatorSequence: Through the existing DigitalOcean console transfer only these two public, secret-free files to their exact transfer destinations and exact root ownership/modes above.
Verify the two transferred SHA-256 values exactly match this packet before invocation.
Stop on any ownership, mode, symlink, size, hash, member, collision, timeout, installer or rollback refusal; do not substitute a command or legacy helper.
After a successful fixed installation, obtain a fresh Product serialized slot before invoking the qualifier entrypoint.
authorization: Packet publication and review are not server execution authority. Use requires Product acceptance of this exact packet and the already-authorized bounded console installation workflow; qualification still requires a fresh serialized slot.
